avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer may reduce quinagolide plasma concentrations and efficacy; potential loss of prolactin suppression
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative herbal supplements

avoid_supplements.name: Antipsychotic herb combinations (e.g., high-dose kava)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May antagonize dopaminergic effects of quinagolide and increase CNS side effects
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue and consult physician before use

caution_supplements.name: Grapeseed extract/Grapefruit extracts
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may slightly increase quinagolide levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased side effects (nausea, dizziness, headache); dose adjustment may be needed

caution_supplements.name: Milk thistle
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential CYP3A4 modulation with variable effects
caution_supplements.action: Monitor prolactin levels and clinical response; report any changes to physician

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases quinagolide bioavailability and plasma concentrations, elevating risk of adverse effects
avoid_foods.action: Eliminate from diet; no grapefruit consumption during quinagolide therapy

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay quinagolide absorption and affect peak concentration timing
caution_foods.action: Take quinagolide consistently with or without food; maintain routine for consistent therapeutic levels

caution_foods.name: Tyramine-rich foods (aged cheeses, cured meats, fermented products)
caution_foods.mechanism: Dopamine agonists may have minor interactions with tyramine metabolism; quinagolide has low hypertensive risk profile
caution_foods.action: Moderation advised; monitor blood pressure if consuming large amounts

monitoring_notes: Monitor prolactin levels, blood pressure, and cardiovascular status during therapy. Report any signs of ergotism, valvular dysfunction, or CNS effects; dose adjustments may be needed if CYP3A4 inhibitors/inducers are initiated or discontinued.
